deliver.title: Deliver invoice items
deliver.description: Complete the selected items for this invoice and delivery.
deliver.unavailable: You do not have access to complete this delivery.
deliver.loadError: Unable to load the items for this delivery.
deliver.changed: The barcode assignment changed. Close and reopen the delivery to review the current items.
deliver.statusHint: Applied to every barcode listed above.
deliver.statusRequired: Select the new status for these barcodes.
deliver.documentsHint: Add delivery documents, photos, or videos. Files are saved to this invoice as delivery_1, delivery_2, and so on, keeping their extensions. Uploaded files remain saved even if you close without delivering.
deliver.pendingDocuments: Upload or remove the queued files before delivering.
deliver.termsLoadError: Unable to load the terms and conditions. Retry before delivering.
deliver.noTerms: There are no active terms and conditions.
deliver.agree: The delivery receiver has read and agrees to the terms and conditions listed above.
deliver.agreementRequired: The delivery receiver must agree to the terms and conditions.
deliver.receiverHint: Enter the actual person receiving the merchandise. Their signature stays private on this invoice.
deliver.signatureCoversTerms: One signature confirms both: this person received the items listed above and agrees to the terms and conditions.
deliver.signatureCoversDelivery: The signature confirms this person received the items listed above.
deliver.signatureSaved: The delivery receiver signature is saved. Retry to finish updating the barcode status.
deliver.signatureRequired: Draw the delivery receiver’s signature before delivering.

wizard.title: Complete delivery

hints.review: Select only the pieces the customer is receiving on this delivery.
hints.signature: The person receiving may be different from the invoice customer.
hints.finish: Check the selected items, uploaded photos and receiver before completing.

wizard.remainingConduce: Items you do not select remain {{pendingStatus}} for the next trip.
wizard.selectItems: Select at least one item to deliver.
wizard.photoHint: Take photos or drop image files here.
wizard.photoLimits: 1–12 photos · Up to 25 MB each · Images only
wizard.photoRequired: Add at least one merchandise photo before continuing.
wizard.savedWithInvoice: Photos upload when you continue and remain stored with this invoice.
wizard.validReceiverId: Enter the actual receiver ID (up to 64 characters, no line breaks).
wizard.automaticMetadata: The signing date and collecting employee are recorded automatically.
wizard.confirmReceived: Complete only after the customer has received the selected merchandise.
wizard.retrySameReceipt: Retry sends the same receipt safely. If items or terms changed, reopen the wizard to review them.
wizard.successHint: {{count}} items are now {{deliveredStatus}}. The receipt and photos are linked to this invoice and delivery. Unselected items remain {{pendingStatus}}.
